sw.adminPitch:
🇹🇿 Habari {{NAME}} (Admin wa {{GROUP_NAME}})! Hongera sana kwa kazi kubwa ya kuwaunganisha Watanzania wenzetu wa {{HOST_REGION}}.

Mimi ni Peter Swai, Mwanzilishi wa *Diaspora Nearby* — programu mpya inayowaunganisha Watanzania waishio nje ya nchi (ugunduzi wa Watanzania walio karibu nawe mji uliopo, ujenzi wa chemba rasmi za miji na mikoa ya nyumbani Tanzania, na mfuko wa dharura wa Ubuntu).

Kila mwanachama anayejiunga kwenye Epoch 1 anapata tokeni za *$DIASPORA* kwenye *Base Blockchain*, na kila tokeni anayopata mwanachama inazalisha *1:1 Ubuntu Match* moja kwa moja kwenye hazina ya chemba ya mji wenu ({{HOST_REGION}}) na mkoa wa nyumbani Tanzania!

Ningependa kukualika uwe *Kiongozi Mwanzilishi (Founding Chamber Partner)* wa jumuiya hii. Hii hapa ni link na kodi yako maalum ya Admin ambayo inakupa zawadi za DSP kwa kila mwanachama wa grupu lako anayejiunga:
👉 https://diasporanearby.com/invite?code={{CODE}}

Ukiona inafaa, unaweza pia ku-pin ujumbe huu mfupi kwenye grupu letu la {{GROUP_NAME}} ili Watanzania wenzetu wajiunge na chemba ya mji wetu. Ahsante sana na karibu kundini! 🙏🇹🇿

en.adminPitch:
🌍 Hi {{NAME}} (Admin of {{GROUP_NAME}})! Thank you for building such a valuable community for expats and international residents in {{HOST_REGION}}.

I’m Peter Swai, Founder of *Diaspora Nearby* — a platform built for everyone living between a Home Country and a Host Country (like international expats, regional diaspora, diplomats, and professionals living in Tanzania).

On Diaspora Nearby, members can discover compatriots from their home country nearby in {{HOST_REGION}}, build verified peer trust, and organize official Nationality & City Chambers in Tanzania. Every member who joins in Epoch 1 earns *$DIASPORA* on *Base Blockchain*, with a *1:1 Ubuntu Community Match* that mints equal treasury reserves directly into their local Tanzania chamber and their home country treasury.

I’d love to invite you as a *Founding Chamber Partner* for {{GROUP_NAME}}. Here is your dedicated Admin invite link (which credits you with DSP referral rewards for every group member who joins):
👉 https://diasporanearby.com/invite?code={{CODE}}

Would you be open to pinning a short welcome post in {{GROUP_NAME}} so members can join their nationality & city hubs in Tanzania? Happy to share a ready-to-post snippet!
